whySaudiArabia.title: Why Saudi Arabia?
whySaudiArabia.description: Saudi Arabia is rapidly emerging as the premier destination for business, thanks to its strategic initiatives and forward-thinking reforms. The Kingdom's Vision 2030 plan is transforming the economic landscape, fostering a business-friendly environment with reduced bureaucratic hurdles and enhanced infrastructure. With a strategic location at the crossroads of major international trade routes, Saudi Arabia offers unparalleled access to global markets. Additionally, the country's robust economy, rich natural resources, and commitment to innovation make it a magnet for investment. The introduction of 100% foreign ownership policies further enhances its appeal, providing unprecedented opportunities for international entrepreneurs to thrive. Choose Saudi Arabia for its dynamic market, strategic advantages, and progressive economic vision.
whySaudiArabia.extraDescription: Under Vision 2030, the Kingdom is opening its doors to the world, offering unprecedented opportunities for investors, entrepreneurs, and explorers alike.

features.title: Vision 2030
features.description: The ambitious Vision 2030 reform plan is driving massive economic diversification and development across various sectors, creating numerous opportunities for foreign and local investors.

features.title: Ease of Doing Business
features.description: Saudi Arabia has introduced major regulatory reforms to streamline business setup processes, attract foreign investment, and improve the overall ease of doing business in the Kingdom.

features.title: Strategic Location
features.description: Located at the crossroads of three continents (Asia, Africa, and Europe), Saudi Arabia provides excellent access to international markets, making it a prime hub for global business expansion.

features.title: Economic Stability
features.description: As the largest economy in the Middle East and with robust financial reserves, Saudi Arabia offers a stable and secure environment for long-term investment.

features.title: Growing Sectors
features.description: Key industries like technology, healthcare, real estate, and tourism are experiencing rapid growth, fueled by government initiatives and private sector investments.

features.title: 100% Foreign Ownership
features.description: Recent changes in investment laws allow for 100% foreign ownership in various sectors, giving businesses full control over their operations.

faqs.question: How long does it take to register a foreign company in Saudi Arabia?
faqs.answer: Normally, setting up a company and registering with MISA takes between 2 to 4 weeks, depending on the commercial license type and ministry clearances.

faqs.question: Can you arrange custom family visit and tourist packages?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our team crafts custom tourism solutions, arranging premium accommodation, luxury land transportation, tour guides, and fast visa approvals.

sections.title: Company History & Vision
sections.subtitle: Strategic Bridgeholders of Global Ambitions
sections.content: Founded in 2009, KH Dream Services Limited has evolved from a boutique administrative agency into Saudi Arabia's preeminent full-service corporate advisory and luxury travel gateway. Over 17 years of operational excellence, we have designed customized compliance-assured frameworks that empower foreign conglomerates, multi-family offices, and global startups to register, operate, and scale seamlessly in the GCC region. We combine deep institutional knowledge of local administrative codes with world-class travel speed.

sections.title: CEO Message
sections.subtitle: Corporate Vision under Vision 2030
sections.content: Under Vision 2030, Saudi Arabia is experiencing an unprecedented era of economic expansion. Our mission is to pave a seamless, compliance-assured gateway for entrepreneurs and enterprises to establish their presence and thrive in the Kingdom. We combine localized legal intelligence with premium global concierge services, ensuring your travel and corporate setup are executed with absolute discretion and excellence. We do not simply process applications; we secure your legacy in the Kingdom.

sections.title: Our Core Pillars
sections.subtitle: Mission & Absolute Value Delivery
sections.content: We commit to speed, absolute compliance, and tailored luxury operations. Whether securing complex foreign investment permits or managing pristine VIP Umrah transfers, we believe in long-term partnerships built on trust, discretion, and executive-level performance.

companyProfile.aboutText: KH Dream Services Limited is a premier corporate advisory institution specializing in high-friction government licensing, commercial registration, and customized corporate operations under Saudi Vision 2030. Over the past 17 years, we have designed customized frameworks that empower foreign conglomerates, multi-family offices, and global startups to register, operate, and scale seamlessly in the GCC region. Our strength lies in deep institutional knowledge of local administrative codes combined with world-class service speed.
companyProfile.missionText: Speed and absolute compliance for setups and premium VIP transfers.
companyProfile.visionText: To be the foremost advisory of choice for global family offices.
companyProfile.relationshipText: At KH Dream Services, relationship stewardship is our absolute core promise. We believe client relations should be proactive rather than responsive. Every corporate contract is paired with a dedicated bilingual Relationship Director (bilingual in English & Arabic) who serves as an active compliance guardian. We establish custom real-time messaging tunnels, schedule bi-weekly operational check-ins, and handle all renewal cycles, ministry correspondence, and regulatory inquiries seamlessly. This ensures you can focus purely on business growth while we safeguard your regulatory health.
companyProfile.relationshipCheckText: Active Compliance Monitoring & Zero Penalty Guarantee
companyProfile.service1Text: We handle the complete corporate lifecycle of foreign entities entering Saudi Arabia. We bypass bureaucratic complexity by directly interfacing with the Ministry of Investment (MISA) and Ministry of Commerce to secure foreign investment permits, commercial registrations (CR), tax registrations, and Chamber of Commerce approvals. We deliver compliance-assured speed.
companyProfile.service2Text: We operate a specialized global visa desk providing structured, turn-key processing for personal, corporate, and investor travel. Our team handles complete dossier preparation, consular pre-checks, secure appointment scheduling, and biometrics organization for travel all across the world.
companyProfile.caseStudiesText: Compelling case studies demonstrating how our dual expertise in MISA licensing and premium executive logistics delivers unmatched turnaround speed and operational safety in the Kingdom.
companyProfile.caseStudy1Challenge: Securing 100% foreign-owned financial services licensing under strict compliance standards.
companyProfile.caseStudy2Challenge: Coordinating industrial warehouse clearances and customs registers across three major economic hubs.
companyProfile.caseStudy2Outcome: Scope: Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam // SLA: Zero Penalties
companyProfile.caseStudy3Challenge: Co-structuring a complex steel JV and securing immediate bilateral custom tariff concessions.
companyProfile.caseStudy3Outcome: Startup Saving: 18% Logistics Capital // Visa Quota: 120 Engineers
companyProfile.guaranteeText: All compliance assertions, Ministry authorizations, and visa quotas correspond directly to regulations of Riyadh Chamber & Ministry of Investment.
companyProfile.footerNote: All corporate credentials are legally verified under the active laws of Saudi Arabia.
